editorGuide: Raja Rajeswari Pathasala — Puranokta curriculum. Only the `tracks` array is loaded into Postgres. Keys `_exampleSingleTrack` and this `editorGuide` are documentation; delete `_exampleSingleTrack` when you no longer need the template. Each live track must match the shape of `_exampleSingleTrack` (extra keys like title_te are allowed on tracks and are ignored by the seeder). Run `npm run db:seed:curriculum:rr` after `npm run db:seed-orgs`.

_exampleSingleTrack.title: Example track title (unique per organization in the database)
_exampleSingleTrack.title_te: Optional: extra display fields are preserved in JSON but not mapped to columns unless product adds them.

chapters.title: Example chapter title (unique per track in the database)

content.en: Optional locale buckets; values are HTML strings.
